description.text:
The Brave Stars V Starter Deck (勇魅群星 V起始卡组) came out on 18 June 2024 with the Brave Stars boosters. Each box held a ready-to-play 60-card deck made up at random from 160 different non-holo cards, every deck with a Pokémon V and some with a Pokémon VSTAR, a VSTAR marker, and a one-card bonus pack: one of 31 cards, 21 non-holo and 10 holo, the holos being rarer.

Its cards are numbered out of 153. The ten holo cards are numbered past that, 154 to 163: Keldeo, Dunsparce, Professor's Research, Boss's Orders, Leafeon VSTAR, Glaceon VSTAR, Zeraora VSTAR, Deoxys VSTAR, Darkrai VSTAR and Energy Switch.
